# v2026.10.18

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.18.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.18.md).

This release covers **11 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Flow starts as its own app, with a PostgreSQL data model for organisations, contacts, the price list and invoices. ([#11](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/11))
- People sign in through Clerk, and Flow keeps their roles. ([#19](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/19))
- Each release ships as an npm package, a container image and a GitHub Release, and a Replit install follows a release channel. ([#18](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/18), [#20](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/20))

## Changes

- PostgreSQL data model for organisations, contacts, price list and invoices. ([#11](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/11))
- Calendar release versions for Flow. ([#17](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/17))
- Release workflows for Flow: npm, GHCR and GitHub Release. ([#18](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/18))
- Replit installs follow a release channel with FLOW_DEPLOY_REF. ([#20](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/20))
- Sign in through Clerk with roles kept in Flow. ([#19](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/19))
- /health reports the release, and Flow says when a newer one is out. ([#22](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/22))

## Contribution record

[CHANGELOG/records/2026.10.18.md](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG/records/2026.10.18.md) lists every pull request in this release once, with its related issues and thanks.
